ContraForce is the Agentic Security Delivery Platform for MSSPs, MSPs, and security operations teams. ContraForce Security Delivery Agents run the entire delivery loop on the Microsoft Security platform: triage, investigation, response, tuning, ticket, report. Gamebooks enforce the same procedure across every client, so your team reviews outcomes instead of producing them.

ContraForce is built for MSSPs and MSPs delivering security across their customers' XDR and SIEM tools, including providers launching a managed security service without first building a SOC. ContraForce bills you, the provider, never your customers, so you keep the customer relationship and set your own price. In-house security operations teams use it too.

ContraForce connects to each customer's security tools and runs every customer from one multitenant control plane. When an incident lands, a Security Delivery Agent triages and investigates it, takes or recommends a response, tunes the detection, updates the ticket, and writes the report under your Gamebooks. Your analysts keep the judgment calls and approve anything reserved for a human.
Will ContraForce act in my customers' environments without my approval?

ContraForce takes response actions only where you allow them. Security Delivery Agents can start by investigating and recommending, with your analysts approving every action. You set approval gates per customer workspace, and an attributable audit trail records every action and approval. When the verdicts hold up on your own incidents, expand autonomy one Gamebook at a time.

ContraForce leaves your customers' logs and telemetry in their own SIEM or XDR and queries them in place. It stores the incident records, verdicts, and evidence its agents produce in a United States, United Kingdom, or European Union deployment. ContraForce does not train or fine-tune AI models on customer data and is independently audited to SOC 2 Type II.
How does ContraForce pricing work?

ContraForce pricing is a monthly plan plus pay-as-you-go investigations, starting at $249 per month. ContraForce hosts and operates the platform, so there is no infrastructure to deploy. Plans are month-to-month and annual billing is discounted. No bundles, no included runs, and no overage tiers.

ContraForce gives service providers the Security Delivery Agents, enforced standard operating procedures (SOPs), and fleet-wide control plane to deliver managed security across every customer environment, profitably, from day one.
Every customer you serve is being told they need managed detection and response. They're asking you for it - and they'd rather buy it from the provider they already trust.

ContraForce is purpose-built for multi-environment delivery. The control plane gives your team visibility and operational control across every customer environment from a single interface. Standard operating procedures (SOPs) can be applied globally or customized per environment.

Delegated access solves who can see what, and it stops there. GDAP and Lighthouse give you multi-environment visibility and access delegation. Access tools show what is happening across your environments; ContraForce does the security delivery work autonomously.

ContraForce uses a federated access model: it operates inside each customer environment, in their region. Logs and telemetry never leave the customer environment. No log duplication. No third-party data custody. This reduces your compliance surface and removes the data residency objections that slow procurement.

Most providers are operational within a week. Connect customer environments, configure Gamebooks, activate agents. ContraForce provides onboarding support to ensure your team is delivering fast.
